ai.title: Cmpnd Releases dspy-wsp: Weight-Space Programming Comes to DSPy
ai.brief: Cmpnd has released dspy-wsp , a prototype optimizer that brings weight-space programming to DSPy . Weight-space programming is a technique in which a frontier LLM reads another model’s weights and edits them directly. There are no gradients, no training loop and no fine-tuning dataset. dspy-wsp packages this as WeightSpace , an optimizer that plugs into any DSPy program and metric. In Cmpnd’s tests, about $5 to $10 of GPT-6-Astra calls improved every decision model they tried. com chrome extension . TL;DR What it is: A DSPy optimizer ( WeightSpace ) where a writer LLM edits a student model’s weights. 5. 6B to 9B parameters. One 25-pass run edited a single layer or head. sec.title: Cursor confirms security breach led to malicious Claude Code extension
sec.brief: Cursor confirmed it suffered a security breach that let hackers distribute a malicious Claude Code extension through its marketplace after stealing credentials from AI infrastructure provider Fireworks AI. The breach also let attackers access internal systems and steal customer data, including historical AI coding-agent traces containing unredacted credentials that were later used to compromise additional services. The breach was disclosed in a new incident report published Friday, which explains how attackers distributed malicious versions of Anthropic's Claude Code extension through Cursor's marketplace on October 29. The attack exposed up to 5,000 developers to malware that installed persistent SSH backdoors. Cursor is an AI-powered code editor built on Microsoft's open-source Visual Studio Code (VS Code), allowing developers to write, modify, and debug software using AI assistants.
